chunks: A group of scholars informed me from Abu Muhammad Hasan ibn Hamza ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) who said: Ali ibn Muhammad al-Kulayni narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Saymari wrote to the Master of the Age (may Allah hasten his reappearance) asking for a shroud to be blessed with what comes from him. A reply came: You will need it in the year eighty-one. He died in the time that was specified, and the shroud was sent to him a month before his death.

key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on him

ai.seo_question: What is the story of the shroud sent to Muhammad ibn Ziyad by the Imam of the Age?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the miraculous knowledge (*'ilm al-ghayb*) of the Imam of the Age, specifically Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.), who accurately predicted the death of Muhammad ibn Ziyad al-Saymari in the year 81 AH. The narrative underscores the spiritual significance of receiving a shroud (*kafan*) directly from the Imam as a blessing, illustrating the tangible connection between the Hidden Imam and his contemporaries during the Minor and Major Ghayba periods.
